newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PSG buys out units for 39.7 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: PSG buys out units for 39.7 mln rand.

text.p: South Africa's PSG Group Ltd, formerly known as PAG Group Ltd, said on Wednesday that it had bought the 50 percent stakes it did not already own in Professional Securities Ltd and PSG Asset Management Ltd.
The total cost of the buy is 39.73 million rand which will be settled by a cash payment of 7.21 million rand and the issue of 4.78 million shares at a price of 6.80 rand a share.
In a seperate agreeement PSG's new wholly-owned unit PSG Risk Managers Ltd is to acquire the Professional Securities gilts trading business.
"It is expected that the acquisitions will have a positive effect on PSG's future earnings," the firm said in a statement.
